name: radio-player-page-dev
description: Development tooling for the WordPress side of Radio Player Page. The player (player/) and each block (blocks/*) are independent projects.

scripts.check: npm run lint:php && npm run test:php:unit && npm run lint:js && npm test && npm run test:hooks && npm run check:player && npm run check:blocks && npm run check:zip
scripts.check:blocks: npm --prefix blocks/schedule run check && npm --prefix blocks/programs-list run check && npm --prefix blocks/now-playing run check
scripts.test:php:integration: wp-env --config .wp-env.tests.json run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/radio-player-page env WORDPRESS_TABLE_PREFIX=wptests_ vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit-integration.xml.dist
scripts.test:php:integration:coverage: rm -rf coverage/php-xml && wp-env --config .wp-env.tests.json run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/radio-player-page env WORDPRESS_TABLE_PREFIX=wptests_ XDEBUG_MODE=coverage vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit-integration.xml.dist --coverage-xml coverage/php-xml
scripts.test:php:integration:ms: wp-env --config .wp-env.tests.json run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/radio-player-page env WORDPRESS_TABLE_PREFIX=wptests_ WP_MULTISITE=1 vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit-integration.xml.dist --group ms-required --exclude-group ms-excluded
